description: Add the Caffino install manifest, branded PNG icons, and document head metadata while retaining the existing SVG favicon and pathname routes.
steps: Generate public/icons/caffino-192.png and public/icons/caffino-512.png from public/images/misc/misc-02.avif with the installed Python Pillow tool, using square crops and the 512px file as maskable.
Create public/manifest.webmanifest with Caffino names, root start URL/scope, standalone display, pt-BR language, description, black/amber colors, and both PNG icon sizes.
Update index.html with the manifest link, theme-color, and Apple mobile web-app metadata while leaving the existing /images/misc/misc-01.svg favicon unchanged.
Run the production build and verify Vite emits the manifest, icons, and favicon at the expected root-relative paths.
acceptance_criteria: The manifest contains name and short_name Caffino, start_url /, display standalone, lang pt-BR, description, coherent theme/background colors, and 192x192 and 512x512 PNG icons.
The built HTML links the manifest and theme/apple metadata, and still links /images/misc/misc-01.svg as favicon.
npm run build passes and emits both icon PNGs, manifest.webmanifest, and the existing favicon.
verification: From /home/caio/projects/templates/caffino-landing run npm run build and confirm it passes.
Run npm run preview and inspect / in a browser; confirm manifest metadata and icon requests succeed and /design-system still renders.
findings: Implemented the manifest, head metadata, and Pillow-generated square PNG icons. Verification record dated 2026-10-30 22:01 -03:00: `npm run build` passed; the build emitted `dist/manifest.webmanifest`, both PNG icons, `dist/sw.js`, and `dist/images/misc/misc-01.svg`. `npm run preview` route and asset checks returned HTTP 200 for `/`, `/design-system`, `/sw.js`, `/manifest.webmanifest`, `/icons/caffino-192.png`, and the existing SVG favicon. Headless Chromium via Playwright 1.64.1 confirmed the production manifest link, `/sw.js` registration, online `/design-system`, cached `/` presence, and offline rendering for `/` and `/design-system`. `npm run dev` rendered `/` with zero service-worker registrations. Full commands and results are recorded in `docs/refinamento/landing/verification.md`.
